title: Held quote
description: A quote a reserve holds for a new route before it starts (REQ-QTE-15): a choice round's decision record, whose chosen candidate is the quote, and the validity stated for the hold. It stays a quote until each segment starts and binds no provider. The record chose a candidate, and the validity is at or after its snapshot was taken, checked by the contract's Rust types.

record.description: The record the quote is from.
